_comment: Per-position P(win) priors for portfolio_kelly.py. cluster + rho_within define correlation-discount applied via Kelly fraction. cluster_frac is the existing-deployment-as-fraction-of-bankroll for that cluster — used as the discount factor.

us-x-iran-permanent-peace-deal-by-may-11.rationale: Strict criteria require formal SIGNED permanent deal. Iran rejected US proposal; 14pt MOU not signed. P(YES) <1% in 1.3d window. P fragile to estimation error.

us-x-iran-permanent-peace-deal-by-may-15.rationale: 6-day window. Iran demands reparations + troop withdrawal infeasible to sign in 6d. P robust.

us-x-iran-permanent-peace-deal-by-may-31.rationale: 2026-05-22 14:30 UMA-risk-adjusted (post operator dialogue + term-structure analysis). Strict-criterion analysis gives P(YES)=15% central, but Iran-peace event term structure (May 22=6.8%, May 26=17.5%, May 31=26.5%, Jun 30=47%, Dec 31=73%) shows market is pricing UMA-LOOSE interpretation (a 73% YES by Dec 31 is incompatible with strict 'permanent only' reading). Weighted 70% strict × 15% + 30% loose × 27.5% = 19% P(YES). P_NO=0.81. EV math: hold 0.81 × $17.44 = $14.13 vs close $12.82 = +$1.31 hold advantage. Cluster cap (per-cluster, iran-peace alone) has $39 headroom; 10pp filter on edge 7.5pp (0.81 - 0.735) FAILS for new entries. Hold existing position only. Decision unchanged.

russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-by-may-31-202.rationale: umaResolutionStatus=disputed. Market pricing YES at 99.95%. Forced hold; effectively lost capital.

will-the-iranian-regime-fall-by-the-end-.rationale: Regime stable; US shelved Project Freedom (de-escalation). 235d window. ANTI-correlated with iran-peace cluster.

will-reza-pahlavi-lead-iran-in-2026.rationale: Conjunction P(regime falls AND Pahlavi installed) very low. ANTI-correlated with iran-peace.

trump-out-as-president-before-2027.rationale: Even with Dem house gains in midterms Nov 2026, Senate conviction implausible. P robust.

hantavirus-pandemic-in-2026.rationale: Hantavirus outbreak constrained; pandemic in 2026 very low base rate.

will-the-us-confirm-that-aliens-exist-be.rationale: Pentagon files released May 8 with explicit 'no alien interaction' statement. Catalyst-check 2026-05-08 P(YES) central 15%.

will-latvia-be-in-the-top-10-at-eurovisi.rationale: Latvia must qualify SF2 (May 14) AND finish top 10 in Grand Final (May 16). Bookies favor non-Baltic odds.

will-atletico-madrid-finish-in-the-top-4.rationale: Atletico mathematically locked in top 4 with 3 games left. Near-certain.
